scenes.visual: Woman pulls a tangled pile of single socks out of the dryer, looks at the camera
scenes.line: Every laundry day I lose at least one sock.

scenes.visual: Close-up: two SockLock socks snap together at the cuff
scenes.line: So I tried socks with tiny magnets in the cuff.

scenes.visual: She tosses the snapped pair into the washer, then pulls it out still together
scenes.line: They go into the wash as a pair and come out as a pair.

scenes.visual: Neat sock drawer, pairs lined up
scenes.line: My sock drawer has never looked this good.

scenes.visual: Product box with 5 pairs, price card
scenes.line: Five pairs for twenty-nine dollars, then a fresh set every quarter. Tap Shop now.
